description: Database is the Schema for the databases API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: Desired configuration of the database and its primary user.

enable.description: Creates a CronJob that dumps the database on the configured schedule.

envFromSecret.description: Name of a Secret whose data is exposed to the backup container as environment variables.

cleanup.description:
Adds this Database as an owner of the Kubernetes resources it creates.
Kubernetes garbage collection then removes those resources with the Database.

credentials.description: Generated credential data and Secret metadata.

metadata.description: Labels and annotations on the generated credential Secret.

extraAnnotations.description:
Annotations to merge into the generated credential Secret.
Values in this map replace existing values for the same keys.

extraLabels.description:
Labels to merge into the generated credential Secret.
Values in this map replace existing values for the same keys.

templates.description: Additional data entries for generated Secrets and ConfigMaps.

name.description: Data key written to the generated Secret or ConfigMap.

secret.description:
Writes the entry to a Secret when true and to a ConfigMap when false.
DbUser templates must set this field to true.

template.description: Go template evaluated with database connection values and template helper functions.

deletionProtected.description:
Keeps the database and its primary user in the database backend
when the Database resource is deleted.

existingUser.description:
Name of an existing database user to use as the primary user.
The operator grants and revokes permissions for this user but does not create or delete it.

extraGrants.description:
Grants other existing database users access to this database.
The referenced DbInstance must set allowExtraGrants to true.

accessType.description: Access level to grant. Supported values are readOnly and readWrite.

instance.description:
Name of the cluster-scoped DbInstance that hosts the database.
This field is immutable.

postgres.description: Settings that apply only to PostgreSQL databases.

dropPublicSchema.description: Removes the public schema after the database is created.

schemas.description: Schemas to create. The primary user receives full access to each schema.

template.description:
PostgreSQL template database used to create this database.
This field is immutable.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret that stores the generated database credentials.

secretsTemplates.description:
Legacy credential templates indexed by Secret data key.
It cannot be used with credentials.templates.

Deprecated: Use credentials.templates instead.

extraGrants.description: Records the grants applied during the last successful reconciliation.

accessType.description: Access level to grant. Supported values are readOnly and readWrite.

operatorVersion.description: The db-operator version that last completed reconciliation.

proxyStatus.description: Connection proxy state and service details.

status.description: True when the proxy is ready.
True after the database reconciles successfully.
